title: pyStrip 回退成一条 /^WS+|WS+$/ 正则（平方级回溯）
from:
let a = 0, b = s.length
  while (a < b && isWs(s[a]!)) a++
  while (b > a && isWs(s[b - 1]!)) b--
  return a === 0 && b === s.length ? s : s.slice(a, b) // py-semantics-ok: 按已扫出的码元下标切，空白集都在 BMP，不涉及码点计数

title: pyStrip 只去左边
from:
while (b > a && isWs(s[b - 1]!)) b--
  return a === 0 && b === s.length

title: pyStrip 只去右边
from:
while (a < b && isWs(s[a]!)) a++
  while (b > a && isWs(s[b - 1]!)) b--

title: pyLstrip 多去了右边
from:
while (a < s.length && isWs(s[a]!)) a++
  return a === 0 ? s : s.slice(a)
to:
while (a < s.length && isWs(s[a]!)) a++
  return pyStrip(a === 0 ? s : s.slice(a))
